import json
gi=G['Test input']; H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
seed=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==1]
S=set(seed); out=[row[:] for row in gi]
allvalid=[]
for di in range(-H,H+1):
    for dj in range(-W,W+1):
        if (di,dj)==(0,0): continue
        p=[(a+di,b+dj) for a,b in seed]
        if all(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and gi[a][b]==0 for a,b in p) and not any((a,b) in S for a,b in p):
            allvalid.append((di,dj))
print(len(allvalid), allvalid[:20])
U=set()
for di,dj in allvalid: U|={(a+di,b+dj) for a,b in seed}
for i,j in U: out[i][j]=1
print(json.dumps(out))
